## Tips (11)

*Key* and *click* in italics are filled in by the game with the player's own bindings (Settings > Controls), e.g. *End round key* shows as Enter by default.

### Rounds

Each round you act first: every tower may use each of its ready abilities. Click End Turn (or press *End round key*) and the enemies move and attack; then new enemies may arrive and the next round starts.

### Placing towers

Towers cost energy. Click a card in your hand at the bottom, then a tile: the tiles you can build on light up. Some levels give energy each round, and selling a tower gives some of its cost back.

### Cooldowns

A number after an ability's name is how many turns it must wait before it can be used again. An ability without one is ready every turn.

### Walking

Towers can walk: pick their walk ability, then a tile. Enemies keep to their roads, and towers never stand on a road.

### Quick cast

*Quick cast click* an ability on the tower panel to use it at once: the tower picks the target by itself, the way it would if nobody aimed it.

### Statuses

The small icons over a unit are its statuses: green ones help, red ones harm. Point at them to see what they do and how long they last.

### Taunt

A taunted enemy goes for the tower that taunted it whenever it can reach it. Use it to keep enemies away from your base and your weaker towers.

### Bosses

Bosses are much tougher than other enemies. Some abilities hurt them more: the Priest's Smite hits a boss three times as hard.

### Losing a level

When an enemy destroys your base, the level is lost. You keep every tower you own; Retry and try another plan.

### The camera

Drag the map with the mouse (hold the left or middle button and move), zoom with the mouse wheel, and rotate it with *Rotate left key* and *Rotate right key*. *Camera up key* *Camera left key* *Camera down key* *Camera right key* or pushing the pointer to the edge of the screen move it too.

### Keys

Every key can be changed in Settings > Controls. A key given to two actions shows in red there.
